args.sql:
SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    e.ffactorcurr AS fill_factor,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.initdate) AS years_since_setup,
    (efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'anndegrate')::NUMERIC AS degradation_rate
FROM 
    performance AS p
JOIN 
    electrical AS e ON p.solmodref = e.engyunitref
JOIN 
    plant AS pl ON e.engyunitref = pl.growregistry;
